title: DEF Dosing Unit Open Circuit
shortDescription: ECM has detected an open circuit in the diesel exhaust fluid (DEF) dosing valve injector circuit.
fullDescription:
The Caterpillar ECM monitors current draw on the DEF dosing valve solenoid. When current is below threshold, it logs SPN 3361 FMI 5 indicating an electrical open. Engine will derate after extended fault duration to protect aftertreatment.

Common on C7, C9, C13 and C15 ACERT/SCR engines. Failure to clear within 50 hours triggers a 25 percent torque derate per EPA regulations.

causes.cause: Damaged dosing unit harness or chafed wire
Corroded or unseated dosing unit connector

symptoms: No DEF spray heard during regen

fixSteps.title: Read active and inactive faults
fixSteps.instruction: Connect Cat ET or heavy-truck scan tool, capture freeze frame for SPN 3361.

fixSteps.title: Inspect dosing unit connector
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect harness at DEF dosing valve, check for green corrosion, bent pins, water intrusion. Clean with electrical contact cleaner.

fixSteps.title: Measure dosing valve resistance
fixSteps.instruction: With key off, measure across solenoid pins. Spec is 10-14 ohms at 20C. Open or out-of-spec means replace dosing valve.

fixSteps.title: Replace DEF dosing valve
fixSteps.instruction: Drain DEF lines, unbolt dosing valve from SCR inlet, install new unit with new gasket, torque to 8 Nm.

fixSteps.title: Force regen and clear codes
fixSteps.instruction: Run parked regen via Cat ET, monitor DEF dosing actual vs commanded, clear inactive faults.

whenToCallPro: If derate is active and you lack Cat ET, take to a certified Cat dealer to avoid permanent 5 mph limp mode.
videoSearchQuery: Caterpillar SPN 3361 DEF dosing valve replacement

faq.a: Yes, after 50 hours of an active fault EPA mandates a 25 percent torque derate, then 5 mph limp.

faq.q: Can I just clear the code?
faq.a: No, the ECM will reset it within minutes if the underlying open circuit is not repaired.

title: DEF Pump Pressure Low
shortDescription: DEF supply module is unable to build commanded pressure.
fullDescription:
Caterpillar SCR aftertreatment requires roughly 9 bar of DEF rail pressure. SPN 4334 FMI 1 sets when measured pressure stays below the lower threshold during build-up.

Usually caused by a clogged DEF filter, frozen lines, contaminated DEF, or a worn pump diaphragm in the supply module.

fixSteps.title: Test DEF concentration
fixSteps.instruction: Use refractometer, must read 32.5 percent urea. If off, drain and refill with fresh DEF.

fixSteps.title: Replace DEF main filter
fixSteps.instruction: Locate filter on supply module, unscrew cap, install new filter element and O-ring.

fixSteps.title: Run pressure build-up test
fixSteps.instruction: Use Cat ET DEF system test, watch pressure climb to 9 bar in under 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Replace DEF supply module if pressure low
fixSteps.instruction: Drain tank, disconnect lines, swap pump module, prime system.

whenToCallPro: Pump module replacement requires Cat ET to commission and prime properly.
videoSearchQuery: Caterpillar DEF pump pressure low SPN 4334

faq.a: Yes. DEF older than 12 months or stored above 30C breaks down and clogs filters.

title: DEF Tank Level Low
shortDescription: Diesel exhaust fluid level has dropped below the warning threshold.
fullDescription:
FMI 17 indicates data valid but below normal, least severe. Cat trucks warn at 10 percent, 5 percent, then derate at empty.

Top off the DEF tank with ISO 22241 fluid only. Do not use water or contaminated DEF.

fixSteps.title: Refill DEF
fixSteps.instruction: Add ISO 22241 DEF until tank reads above 50 percent.

fixSteps.title: Verify level reads correctly
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle key, watch dash gauge. If level still reads low, sensor or header unit is faulty.

fixSteps.title: Replace DEF header unit if needed
fixSteps.instruction: Drain tank, remove level sender from top of tank, install new unit and seal.

whenToCallPro: Only if level sensor replacement fails to clear the code.
videoSearchQuery: Caterpillar DEF tank level low SPN 1761

title: Aftertreatment SCR System Severe Derate
shortDescription: SCR system has reached the most severe inducement, vehicle limited to 5 mph.
fullDescription:
SPN 5246 FMI 0 is the EPA-mandated final inducement when an SCR fault is ignored long enough. The engine speed is limited to idle and vehicle to 5 mph until the underlying fault is repaired and a forced regen is completed.

This is always preceded by another SCR fault (NOx sensor, DEF quality, dosing pressure). Fix the root cause first.

causes.cause: DEF quality out of spec for >50 hours

fixSteps.title: Diagnose root SCR fault
fixSteps.instruction: Pull all active and inactive aftertreatment codes with Cat ET, repair upstream cause first.

fixSteps.title: Repair source fault
fixSteps.instruction: Replace failed sensor, dosing valve, or correct DEF quality.

fixSteps.title: Run forced regen
fixSteps.instruction: Use Cat ET to command parked regen, then key cycle. Inducement clears after successful regen and clean drive cycle.

whenToCallPro: Always. Final inducement requires dealer-level diagnostics and EPA compliance procedure.

faq.a: No. The truck is limited to 5 mph and must be repaired or towed.

title: DPF Differential Pressure High
shortDescription: Pressure drop across the diesel particulate filter is above the upper threshold.
fullDescription:
The differential pressure sensor measures soot loading on the DPF. When delta-P exceeds limits, the ECM sets SPN 3251 FMI 0 and demands a regen.

If passive and active regens fail, the filter is overloaded and may need a forced parked regen or removal for ash cleaning.

causes.cause: Excessive soot loading from short trips or idling
Failed regen attempts due to other faults
Faulty differential pressure sensor or plugged hoses

fixSteps.title: Verify DP sensor with Cat ET
fixSteps.instruction: At idle, delta-P should read under 1 kPa. If pegged or zero with engine off, sensor or hose is faulty.

fixSteps.title: Inspect and clear DP sensor lines
fixSteps.instruction: Remove silicone hoses, blow out with compressed air. Replace if cracked.

fixSteps.title: Perform parked regen
fixSteps.instruction: Run forced regen via Cat ET, exhaust temp must reach 600C for 30 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Send DPF for ash cleaning
fixSteps.instruction: If regen fails to lower delta-P, remove DPF and send to ash cleaning service or replace.

whenToCallPro: If forced regen fails, DPF removal and bake/cleaning is a dealer or specialist job.

faq.a: Most highway-driven trucks regen passively. If you idle a lot, force a manual regen weekly.

title: DPF Soot Load Very High
shortDescription: Calculated soot load exceeds maximum, immediate parked regen required.
fullDescription:
When soot estimation crosses the upper alarm, Cat sets SPN 3719 FMI 0 and lights the high soot lamp. If the operator does not initiate a parked regen, the engine will derate, then enter limp.

Driving the truck under load on the highway is sometimes enough to clear it, but a parked regen is the recommended fix.

causes.cause: Faulty fuel injector causing rich mixture

fixSteps.title: Initiate parked regen
fixSteps.instruction: Park, set brake, neutral, hold regen switch. Cycle takes 30-60 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Diagnose if regen fails
fixSteps.instruction: Connect Cat ET, check EGT inlet/outlet, fuel system pressure, doser injector.

fixSteps.title: Repair upstream fault
fixSteps.instruction: Replace fuel doser, leaking injector, or failed turbo as indicated.

whenToCallPro: Only if a parked regen does not bring soot load down.

faq.q: Will it hurt the engine to drive?
faq.a: Continuing to suppress regens can melt the DPF substrate, a $4000+ part.

title: Boost Pressure Sensor Voltage High
shortDescription: Manifold absolute pressure (boost) sensor signal is above expected range.
fullDescription:
Cat ECM expects the boost sensor signal to fall within 0.5-4.5V. FMI 3 indicates an above-normal voltage, usually from an open ground or a shorted-to-power signal wire.

The ECM substitutes a default boost value and the engine runs in low-power limp.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor connector
fixSteps.instruction: Check for oil contamination from blow-by, clean with electrical cleaner.

fixSteps.title: Voltage test
fixSteps.instruction: With key on, signal pin should be 0.5V. Reads 5V means short to power; replace sensor.

fixSteps.title: Replace boost sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Located on intake manifold. Unbolt, install new sensor with O-ring, torque to 8 Nm.

whenToCallPro: Wiring damage diagnosis is faster with a dealer scan tool harness break-out box.

faq.q: Is the sensor at the intake?
faq.a: Yes, threaded into the intake manifold near the EGR valve.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Open Circuit
shortDescription: Open circuit detected in the cylinder 1 fuel injector solenoid.
fullDescription:
Each Cat HEUI or common-rail injector has its own driver in the ECM. FMI 5 is current below normal, indicating the injector solenoid winding is open or the harness has broken.

The affected cylinder is dropped, causing rough idle and a power loss roughly proportional to the cylinder count.

causes.cause: Loose injector connector under valve cover

fixSteps.title: Run cylinder cut-out test
fixSteps.instruction: Use Cat ET cylinder cutout to verify cylinder 1 is not contributing.

fixSteps.title: Pull valve cover
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rocker cover, inspect injector harness pass-through and connector for oil/damage.

fixSteps.title: Test injector resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Spec is 0.3-0.5 ohms. Open reading confirms internal failure.

fixSteps.title: Replace injector and reprogram trim code
fixSteps.instruction: Install new injector with new O-rings, torque hold-down, enter 12-digit trim code into Cat ET.

whenToCallPro: Trim code programming and torque-to-yield procedures benefit from dealer-grade tools.

faq.q: Do I have to enter a trim code?
faq.a: Yes, otherwise the new injector will not deliver accurate fuel quantity.

title: Fuel Delivery Pressure Low
shortDescription: Fuel transfer pump is not maintaining minimum supply pressure to the high-pressure pump.
fullDescription:
Cat C-series engines need 35-65 psi of low-pressure fuel feed. SPN 94 FMI 1 indicates pressure dropped below minimum, often from a clogged primary filter, failing transfer pump, or air leak on the suction side.

Low supply pressure starves the HEUI/common-rail pump and causes hard start, low power, and stalling.

fixSteps.title: Replace primary and secondary filters
fixSteps.instruction: Drain water separator, install new elements, prime system.

fixSteps.title: Test supply pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Tap a gauge into the test port, expect 35-65 psi at idle.

fixSteps.title: Inspect for air leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Pressurize suction side to 5 psi, look for bubbles in clear section or use smoke tester.

fixSteps.title: Replace transfer pump
fixSteps.instruction: Bolt-on unit on side of high-pressure pump or block. Use new gasket.

whenToCallPro: If the high-pressure pump shows wear from running starved, dealer service needed.

faq.a: Yes, plugged tank pickup screen or kinked supply hose will starve the pump.

title: EGR Differential Pressure Sensor High
shortDescription: EGR delta-P sensor signal voltage is above the upper limit.
fullDescription:
Cat C13/C15 engines use a delta-P sensor across an EGR orifice to compute mass flow. FMI 3 means voltage above normal, typically from a plugged sensor port or shorted signal wire.

With bad EGR feedback, the ECM disables EGR, causing high NOx and a regulatory fault.

causes.cause: Short to power on signal wire

fixSteps.title: Remove and clean sensor lines
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the steel tubes from EGR cooler, clean carbon with brake cleaner and wire.

fixSteps.title: Voltage check sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Reference voltage 5V, signal at engine off should be ~2.5V. Replace if pegged high.

fixSteps.title: Replace EGR delta-P sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Unbolt sensor, install new with new O-rings.

whenToCallPro: If carbon plugging is severe enough that EGR cooler needs cleaning.
videoSearchQuery: Caterpillar EGR delta P sensor SPN 411

faq.a: Yes, the ECM substitutes a value but emissions are out of spec.
